rows.Origin:
Bred by David C. H. Austin (1926-2018) (United Kingdom, before 2014).
Introduced in United Kingdom by David Austin Roses Limited (UK) in 2014 as 'The Lady of the Lake'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink. Moderate fragrance. Average diameter 2". Medium, semi-double to double, cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Bronze-green foliage.

Height: up to 12' (up to 365cm).
rows.Patents:
Australia - Application No: 2018/138 on 16 May 2018 VIEW PBR PATENT
Breeders' code: E-26B-09

Application wihdrawn on September 11, 2019.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: The Lady of the Lake is the ruler of Avalon in the King Arthur saga.
